faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How much does a professional website cost?
faq.a1: Prices start from €500 for landing pages and from €1,500 for business websites. Since every project is different, we are happy to provide you with a transparent quote.
faq.a2: Landing pages from 3 days, business websites from 7 days, online shops from 14 days. The exact timeframe depends on scope and requirements.
faq.a3: Yes, basic SEO is included in every project. This includes technical optimizations, fast load times, mobile optimization and clean metadata.
faq.a4: Yes, we develop modern Shopify shops and custom e-commerce solutions. Whether a simple shop or a complex integration — we have the necessary expertise.
faq.a5: Yes, we work with transparent fixed prices. You know from the start what your website costs, there are no hidden additional costs.
faq.a6: After launch, we support you with maintenance and optimization. On request, we also offer regular updates, monitoring and performance improvements.
